title: Learning Rate & Hyperparameters — Settings Interact
key_insight: Hyperparameters form a system, not independent knobs. Batch size affects update noise and hardware use; learning rate and warmup often need to change with it.
body:
## Settings Interact

A learning rate works for a small batch but fails after the batch becomes eight times larger. The amount of gradient noise changed too.

Hyperparameters form a system, not independent knobs. Batch size affects update noise and hardware use; learning rate and warmup often need to change with it.

Log every setting with the result and random seed. Without that record, a good run cannot be reproduced or compared fairly.
common_mistakes: The learning rate is the model’s final accuracy.
Hyperparameters are always discovered perfectly without experiments.
Warmup begins with the largest possible update.
mini_exercise: Sketch the situation in “Settings Interact” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Good architecture can fail when its training settings make steps unstable, slow, or poorly timed.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “Settings Interact” situation, explain Learning Rate & Hyperparameters without assuming the listener knows deep learning.
